title: Walking Tour of France
author: North Star Travelers
description: Welcome to Walking Tour of France, a podcast dedicated to bringing you a new adventure somewhere in France with every episode. Each week we'll travel to a different destination -- from medieval châteaux and stunning gardens to fascinating cities, historic landmarks and hidden gems tucked away across this incredible country.
